name: CoinTower
brief: Coins on a tower: a floor with a SpawnLocation and a staircase of 4 steps going up to a top platform; one coin sits on each step and two on the top. Coins are worth 5 points.
contract: Each coin is a Part named Coin with CanCollide = false, about 2 studs above the surface it sits on.
Steps must be low enough to walk or jump up (each at most 3 studs higher than the one before).
leaderstats IntValue named Coins starting at 0; each coin adds 5 and is destroyed.
